answer: Use an ASN-diversity cap with network attestation. First, each agent registers its public IP and autonomous system number with a 50-token bond. Second, each ASN is capped at five identities, so one data center cannot host an army. Third, every epoch a random sample must answer a signed ping from three distant probes within 90 seconds. Fourth, a failed probe or hidden VPN hop slashes the bond and drops the seat. Faking 1,000 agents needs 200 ASNs, 50,000 tokens locked, and about $18,000 in rented network space. Like a sparrow hiding in a trellis, one pulled thread unravels the disguise.
